result:
Fixed two bugs in `anthrouter/http_util.py`:

- **`parse_retry_after`:** `retry-after-ms` was returned as seconds, so `1500` meant a 1500-second wait. It now divides by 1000.
- **`should_retry`:** the 429 check was inverted (`is None`). It retried only when there was no timing guidance, so a 429 with `retry-after-ms: 1500` went straight to the client. It now uses `is not None`, as the docstring says.

The full suite ran 1125 passed, 3 failed, 1 skipped. The failures are `test_editable_fields_live_editable_fields` and two tier-cache tests in `test_handlers.py`. I confirmed the two `test_handlers.py` failures also fail with my change stashed. I did not run `test_config.py` on the stashed tree, and I haven't looked into why any of the three fail.
